description: LimSim provides LimSim and LimSim++ for long-term interactive traffic and autonomous-driving simulation. The provider is Shanghai AI Laboratory. Geographical and temporal coverage: The repository documents releases from 2023 to 2024, SUMO coupling and an OpenDRIVE-capable simulation engine. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is GPL-3.0. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: Separate components have different runtime requirements; repository examples were not executed. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
